Inspection record verifying dampproofing prior to backfill

rules.title: Crawl space ventilation openings to exterior
rules.intent: Provide minimum net area of ventilation openings to the exterior in crawl spaces, including those used in passive submembrane radon depressurization systems.
evidence_required: Foundation plan showing crawl space vent locations, types, and net free area calculation
Crawl space ventilation calculation referencing R408.1
Manufacturer data for vent assemblies including net free-area rating

rules.title: Wildfire ember- and flame-resistant ventilation openings
rules.intent: Prevent building ignition during wildfire by blocking ember and flame intrusion through attic, eave, soffit, foundation, and crawl-space ventilation openings in Fire Hazard Severity Zones.

options.listing: California State Fire Marshal Wildfire Flame and Ember Resistant Vent

evidence_required: Vent product cut sheets showing CSFM WUI listing or ASTM E2886 test report and listing
Vent schedule on plans identifying location, model, and listing for each ventilation opening
Manufacturer mesh specification (1/16 inch minimum, 1/8 inch maximum) for off-ridge / ridge / dormer vents on sloped roofs
Documentation that mesh material is noncombustible and corrosion resistant

rules.title: Asphalt shingle installation, slope, fastening, and wind classification
rules.intent: Ensure asphalt shingle roof coverings are installed on adequate substrate and slope, are fastened correctly, and are wind-classified for the site's design wind speed so that the roof remains weathertight and resists wind uplift.

exceptions.substitute: Shingles shall instead be tested and labeled to ASTM D3161 and meet the classification in Table R905.2.4.1; packaging shall bear an ASTM D3161 compliance label.

evidence_required: Roof plan showing slope; details for double underlayment where slope is between 2:12 and 4:12
Manufacturer product data sheet for asphalt shingles citing ASTM D3462
Shingle package label or third-party test report showing ASTM D7158 (or ASTM D3161 fallback) classification meeting Table R905.2.4.1 for the site ultimate design wind speed
Site ultimate design wind speed (Vult) value used for selecting the shingle classification
Fastener specification (12 ga min, 3/8 inch head, ASTM F1667) and nailing schedule (4 per strip / 2 per individual) noted on roofing details

rules.title: Clay and concrete tile roof installation, slope, materials, and attachment
rules.intent: Ensure clay and concrete roof tiles are installed on adequate sheathing and slope, meet referenced material standards, and are anchored to resist wind uplift, snow, and high-wind / tall-building exposures.

exceptions.substitute: Spaced lumber sheathing in accordance with Section R803.1 is permitted in lieu of solid sheathing for tile roofs in Seismic Design Categories A, B, and C.

evidence_required: Roof plan showing slope and deck construction (solid sheathing, or spaced lumber with SDC documentation)
Tile product data sheet citing ASTM C1167 (clay) or ASTM C1492 (concrete)
Site ultimate design wind speed and roof height-above-grade noted on plans, with manufacturer's high-wind / tall-building installation instructions when triggers are met
Fastening schedule (corrosion-resistant 11 ga nails, penetration, perimeter and snow-area attachments) keyed to Table R905.3.7
Snow-area determination if applicable, with two-fastener-per-tile detail

rules.title: Metal roof shingle installation, slope, materials, and wind resistance
rules.intent: Ensure metal roof shingle assemblies use corrosion-resistant materials, are installed only on adequate slopes, and are wind-tested and classified for the site's design wind speed.
evidence_required: Roof plan showing slope (>= 3:12) and deck type (solid / closely fitted, or manufacturer's spaced-sheathing listing)
Manufacturer cut sheet referencing Table R905.10.3(1) material standard and corrosion-resistance per Table R905.10.3(2) (e.g., ASTM A653 G90, ASTM A792 AZ 50, ASTM B370)
Wind-resistance test report per ASTM D3161, FM 4474, UL 580, or UL 1897
Site ultimate design wind speed and matching ASTM D3161 classification per Table R905.4.4.1, with package label evidence
Valley flashing detail showing material per Table R905.10.3(1), 8 inch minimum extension, and 3/4 inch splash diverter rib

rules.title: Metal roof panel slope, materials, corrosion resistance, and attachment
rules.intent: Ensure metal roof panel systems are installed at slopes appropriate to their seam type, use corrosion-resistant materials, and are attached with compatible fasteners to remain weathertight and durable.
evidence_required: Roof plan showing seam type (lapped without sealant / lapped with sealant / standing seam) and slope meeting the corresponding minimum
Manufacturer cut sheet citing Table R905.10.3(1) material standard and corrosion-resistance per Table R905.10.3(2)
For structural metal-sheet systems: structural design calculations per the California Building Code
Fastener specification compatible with the panel metal (galvanized for steel, copper/brass/bronze/300-series stainless for copper, stainless acceptable for metal in general) shown on roofing details
Underlayment specification per Section R905.1.1

rules.title: Construct Methods ABW, PFH, PFG, CS-PF and BV-WSP per Sections R602.10.6.1 through R602.10.6.5
rules.intent: Direct designers using any of the special prescriptive bracing methods (ABW, PFH, PFG, CS-PF, BV-WSP) to the controlling construction provisions so the panels develop the assumed lateral capacity.
evidence_required: Bracing schedule on plans identifying each panel by method (ABW, PFH, PFG, CS-PF, or BV-WSP)
Cross-references on the structural sheets pointing each method back to its governing subsection (R602.10.6.1 through R602.10.6.5)
Construction details consistent with the figures and tables called out in the relevant subsection

rules.title: Method ABW alternate braced wall panels: build per Figure R602.10.6.1 with Table R602.10.6.1 hold-down forces
rules.intent: Ensure ABW panels achieve their prescribed lateral capacity by following the standard ABW construction figure and the tabulated hold-down forces that anchor uplift at the panel ends.
evidence_required: Wall panel detail matching Figure R602.10.6.1 (sheathing, fasteners, anchor bolts, panel length)
Hold-down schedule with manufacturer/model and design force taken from Table R602.10.6.1
Anchor bolt and foundation detail at each ABW panel end consistent with Figure R602.10.6.1
Identification of each ABW panel on the bracing plan with length and hold-down callout

rules.title: Method PFH portal frame with hold-downs: construct per Figure R602.10.6.2
rules.intent: Require PFH portal frame panels to follow the prescriptive figure that defines sheathing, framing, strap, and hold-down detailing necessary for the portal-frame load path.
evidence_required: Portal frame detail on plans matching Figure R602.10.6.2 (header size, strap, sheathing nailing, hold-downs)
Hold-down schedule and anchorage detail at each PFH panel
Bracing plan identifying each PFH panel location, header height (max 10 ft, 12 ft with pony wall), and panel length
Foundation/anchor bolt detail at the PFH panel base consistent with Figure R602.10.6.2

rules.title: Method PFG portal frame at garage: permitted only in SDC A, B, C and only supporting a roof or one story plus roof
rules.intent: Limit the prescriptive PFG garage portal frame to the seismic and gravity conditions for which Figure R602.10.6.3 was developed, preventing its use in higher seismic categories or under stacked-story loading.
evidence_required: Seismic Design Category determination for the project (must be A, B, or C for PFG use)
Story count documentation showing PFG panel supports at most one story plus roof
Portal frame detail at the garage opening matching Figure R602.10.6.3 (header, sheathing, strap, hold-down, anchorage)
Bracing plan locating each PFG panel adjacent to a garage door opening with header height (max 10 ft, 12 ft with pony wall) and panel length

rules.title: Method CS-PF continuously sheathed portal frame: construct per Figure R602.10.6.4 and Table R602.10.6.4
rules.intent: Ensure CS-PF panels in continuously sheathed walls deliver their tabulated lateral capacity by following both the prescriptive construction figure and the geometric/length requirements of Table R602.10.6.4.
evidence_required: Continuous sheathing demonstrated along the full braced wall line containing the CS-PF panel
Portal frame detail matching Figure R602.10.6.4 (header, sheathing, fasteners, strap, hold-downs, anchorage)
Panel length, header height (max 10 ft, 12 ft with pony wall), and adjacent opening dimensions taken from Table R602.10.6.4
Bracing plan identifying each CS-PF panel and demonstrating compliance with the contributing length rules of Table R602.10.5

rules.title: Storm water drainage and retention during construction (small projects)
rules.intent: Prevent uncontrolled storm water runoff and erosion from small construction sites by requiring drainage management consistent with CALGreen Chapter 4, Division 4.1.

requires.compliance_with: California Green Building Standards Code, Chapter 4, Division 4.1
requires.scope: manage storm water drainage during construction

evidence_required: Construction storm water management plan referencing CALGreen Chapter 4 Division 4.1
Site plan showing temporary erosion and sediment controls
BMP specifications (silt fence, fiber rolls, inlet protection, stabilized construction entrance)
Designer/contractor declaration of soil disturbance area (acres)

rules.title: Grading and paving must keep surface water out of buildings
rules.intent: Ensure permanent site grading and drainage direct surface water away from buildings to protect habitable space from water intrusion.

requires.performance: site grading or drainage system manages all surface water flows to keep water from entering buildings
requires.compliance_with: California Green Building Standards Code, Chapter 4, Division 4.1

evidence_required: Civil/site grading plan showing finish grade slopes away from building foundations
Drainage system layout (swales, area drains, storm drain tie-ins) on construction plans
Spot elevations and slope arrows demonstrating positive drainage
Note on plans referencing CALGreen Chapter 4 Division 4.1 compliance

rules.title: Scope: Fire-resistant construction provisions for dwellings
rules.intent: Establishes the umbrella trigger for fire-resistant construction requirements covering exterior walls, dwelling-garage separation, fireblocking, floor protection, and finish flame-spread limits.
evidence_required: Code analysis sheet identifying applicable R302 subsections for the project type
Occupancy classification confirming dwelling/accessory building scope

rules.title: Exterior walls: fire-resistance and opening protection by fire separation distance
rules.intent: Limit fire spread between buildings on adjacent lots by requiring fire-resistance ratings, projection limits, and opening/penetration controls based on fire separation distance.
evidence_required: Site plan with dimensioned fire separation distances from each exterior wall to lot lines
Wall assembly UL/GA listing or ASTM E119 test report for any 1-hour rated exterior wall
Door/window schedule showing opening areas with percentage of wall area for walls 3 to 5 ft from lot line
Note on plans identifying which Table (R302.1(1) or R302.1(2)) governs and whether NFPA 13D/R313 sprinklers are installed
Detail of eave/projection construction with fire-retardant-treated wood or 1-hour underside if applicable

rules.title: Dwelling-garage opening and penetration protection
rules.intent: Prevent migration of fire, smoke, and combustion products from a private garage into the dwelling, especially into sleeping rooms.

requires.prohibition: openings from a private garage directly into a room used for sleeping purposes are not permitted
requires.duct_penetrations_per: R302.5.2 (No. 26 gage sheet steel or other approved material; no openings into garage)

evidence_required: Floor plan showing no door from garage opens directly into a bedroom
Door schedule listing thickness/type and 20-minute fire rating where applicable, with self-closing/self-latching hardware
Mechanical drawings showing duct gauge and routing through garage walls/ceiling with no openings into the garage
Penetration firestop details for piping/wiring through dwelling-garage separation

rules.title: Dwelling-garage and/or carport fire separation membrane
rules.intent: Provide a passive gypsum membrane separation between a private garage/carport and the dwelling to delay fire/smoke transfer into living and habitable space above.

minimums.from_residence_and_attics: 1/2-inch gypsum board or equivalent applied to the garage side
minimums.from_habitable_rooms_above_garage_or_car: 5/8-inch Type X gypsum board or equivalent
minimums.garage_<_3_ft_from_dwelling_on_same_lot: 1/2-inch gypsum board or equivalent on interior side of exterior walls within this area

evidence_required: Wall and ceiling assembly details for garage-to-dwelling separation calling out 1/2-inch (or 5/8-inch Type X where habitable space above) gypsum board
Floor plan and section identifying habitable rooms above the garage/carport
Site plan showing distance between detached garage and dwelling on same lot
Gypsum board fastener schedule referencing Table R702.3.5

rules.title: Flame spread and smoke-developed indices for wall and ceiling finishes
rules.intent: Limit the contribution of interior wall and ceiling finishes to fire growth and smoke production within dwellings.

requires.stability: applied or fastened so that materials will not readily become detached at 200°F (93°C) for not less than 30 minutes

criteria: during 40 kW exposure, flames shall not spread to the ceiling
flame shall not spread to the outer extremity of the sample on any wall or ceiling

evidence_required: Manufacturer test reports per ASTM E84/UL 723 (or NFPA 286) for each interior wall/ceiling finish material with FSI and SDI values
Finish schedule listing each interior finish product, its FSI, SDI, and listing reference
Installation details/specs demonstrating stability at 200°F for 30 minutes (mechanical fastening or listed adhesive)
For HDPE/PP finishes: NFPA 286 test report demonstrating compliance with the five performance criteria

rules.title: Fireblocking of concealed draft openings in combustible construction
rules.intent: Cut off concealed vertical and horizontal draft paths in combustible framing so that fire and hot gases cannot travel undetected between stories or between the top story and the roof space.

required_locations: concealed spaces of stud walls and partitions (including furred and parallel/staggered stud spaces) vertically at ceiling and floor levels
concealed spaces of stud walls horizontally at intervals not exceeding 10 feet
interconnections between concealed vertical and horizontal spaces (soffits, drop ceilings, cove ceilings)
concealed spaces between stair stringers at top and bottom of run
openings around vents, pipes, ducts, cables and wires at ceiling and floor level (approved material to resist free passage of flame and combustion products)
cornices of two-family dwellings at the line of dwelling unit separation
approved_materials: two thicknesses of 1-inch nominal lumber with broken lap joints
23/32-inch wood structural panels with backed joints
batts/blankets of mineral wool or glass fiber (securely retained)
cellulose insulation tested per ASTM E119/UL 263 for the specific application
requires.integrity: the integrity of fireblocks shall be maintained

evidence_required: Wall, floor, and stair section details calling out fireblocking locations and material
Note on framing plans requiring 10-ft maximum horizontal fireblocking spacing in stud walls
Penetration detail showing approved material packed around vents/pipes/ducts/cables at floor and ceiling
Fireblocking material specification list (2x lumber, 1/2-inch gypsum, mineral wool batts, etc.)
Special inspection or framing inspection sign-off for fireblocking before close-in

rules.title: Fire protection membrane on underside of floor framing
rules.intent: Provide a minimum gypsum or wood structural panel membrane on the underside of floor framing to slow fire-induced collapse of engineered/light wood floor systems.

requires.location: underside of the floor framing member

evidence_required: Floor framing plan and section showing 1/2-inch gypsum or 5/8-inch wood structural panel membrane on underside of joists/trusses
Sprinkler shop drawings if relying on R313 / NFPA 13D exception
Joist/truss specification (size and species) if relying on 2x10 nominal exception
Detail showing perimeter fireblocking around any unprotected area <= 80 sq ft per story

rules.title: Scope: Light, ventilation and heating for habitable space
rules.intent: Establishes the umbrella trigger for natural/mechanical light and ventilation and heating requirements applicable to habitable rooms and dwelling units.
evidence_required: Code analysis identifying which rooms are habitable per the Chapter 2 definition
Room finish/use schedule distinguishing habitable rooms from bathrooms, closets, halls, storage and utility spaces

rules.title: Habitable rooms: minimum natural light and ventilation
rules.intent: Provide minimum natural daylighting and outdoor-air ventilation to each habitable room, or compensate with mechanical ventilation and artificial light meeting prescribed levels.

requires.ventilation_path: windows, skylights, doors, louvers or other approved openings to the outdoor air
requires.access: ready access or readily controllable by the building occupants

evidence_required: Room-by-room schedule listing floor area, required glazing area (>=8%), and provided glazing area for each habitable room
Window/door schedule showing openable area (>=4% of floor area being ventilated)
Mechanical ventilation calculations and equipment cut sheets if relying on Exception 1 or 2 (whole-house ventilation or kitchen local exhaust)
Lighting calculation demonstrating >=6 footcandles at 30 in above floor where Exception 3 is used
Floor plan and section confirming room qualifies as 'habitable space' per Chapter 2 definition

rules.title: Habitable rooms: minimum floor area and minimum horizontal dimension
rules.intent: Ensure each habitable room is large enough and proportioned to be usable for living, sleeping, eating or cooking.

low_height_area_exclusion.effect: portions below these heights shall not be considered as contributing to the minimum required habitable area

evidence_required: Floor plan with dimensioned habitable rooms showing area >= 70 sq ft and shortest horizontal dimension >= 7 ft
Building section indicating ceiling slope/furring with shaded exclusion of areas below the 5 ft (sloped) / 7 ft (furred) heights
Room schedule classifying each room as habitable vs. non-habitable per Chapter 2 definition
Tabulated calculation of qualifying habitable area (gross area minus low-height exclusions)

rules.title: Minimum ceiling height in habitable space and other rooms
rules.intent: Provide adequate vertical clearance in habitable rooms, hallways, and basements containing them, with reduced minimums for bathrooms, toilet rooms, laundry rooms, and obstruction zones.

rules.applies_to: habitable space, hallways, and portions of basements containing these spaces
bathrooms, toilet rooms, and laundry rooms
portions of basements not containing habitable space or hallways (R305.1.1)

evidence_required: Building sections showing finished ceiling heights in habitable rooms (>=7 ft), bathrooms/toilet rooms/laundry (>=6 ft 8 in), and basements
Floor plan with ceiling height tags by room
Sloped-ceiling compliance diagram showing area with ceiling >=7 ft as a percentage of required floor area, and >=5 ft minimum
Detail at showerhead area showing 30 in x 30 in clear footprint with >=6 ft 8 in clearance
Section through basement showing duct/beam clearances meeting 6 ft 4 in or 78 in projection limits

rules.title: Patio cover design loads minimum 10 psf live and code-prescribed wind
rules.intent: Ensure patio covers can support minimum live load and resist wind so light roof structures over outdoor living areas remain safe.
evidence_required: Structural calculations showing dead + 10 psf live load (or governing snow load) on patio cover
Wind load calculations per R301.2.1 with site-specific Vult
Framing plans and member sizing for the patio cover

rules.title: Nail floor framing per Table R602.3(1) and provide positive uplift/lateral connections at posts and beams

rules.title: Design and fasten exterior wood-frame walls per Figures R602.3(1)-(2) and Tables R602.3(1)-(4); studs continuous from sole to top plate

Fastening schedule on plans matching Tables R602.3(1) through R602.3(4) for sheathing, plates, and studs
Wind-pressure verification for exterior sheathing from Table R301.2.1(1) with height/exposure adjustment from Table R301.2.1(2), keyed to Table R602.3(3) sheathing requirements

rules.title: Connect braced wall panels to floor framing or foundation with rim/blocking and Table R602.3(1) fastening

rules.title: Construct cold-formed steel exterior and interior load-bearing walls per Section R603 (scope)

rules.title: Anchor cold-formed steel walls to foundation/floor per Table R603.3.1 with anchor-bolt placement and embedment
rules.intent: Provide a prescriptive shear-and-uplift connection between CFS walls and the supporting foundation or floor using tabulated screws, anchor bolts, and minimum embedment so the wall transfers lateral and overturning loads.
evidence_required: Foundation/floor anchorage detail showing screws or anchor bolts sized and spaced per Table R603.3.1 for the design wind speed and exposure category
Plan callouts confirming anchor bolts are within 12 inches of corners and ends of bottom tracks
Embedment dimensions on the foundation detail showing ≥15 in into masonry or ≥7 in into concrete
Manufacturer cut sheets and ICC-ES report when foundation anchor straps are substituted for anchor bolts

rules.title: Size cold-formed steel wall studs per Tables R603.3.2(2)-(16); fasten per Table R603.3.2(1); top/bottom tracks match stud thickness
rules.intent: Ensure CFS exterior and interior load-bearing wall studs are sized for the controlling wind, snow, height, and spacing combination and that tracks and fasteners match so axial and lateral capacity assumed in the tables is realized.
evidence_required: CFS stud schedule showing member size, thickness (mils), and steel grade for each wall, keyed to the applicable Table R603.3.2(2) through R603.3.2(16)
Design parameters on the structural cover sheet (ultimate wind speed, exposure category, stud spacing, building width, ground snow load, attic load, story count) matching the table column
Track schedule confirming top and bottom tracks are at least the same thickness as the studs

Connection schedule showing screw type, size, and spacing per Section R603.2.5 and Table R603.3.2(1)

rules.title: Identify, span, and fasten wood structural panel wall sheathing per R604.1-R604.3

evidence_required: Panel specification on plans referencing DOC PS 1, DOC PS 2, ANSI/APA PRP 210, CSA O325, or CSA O437
Photograph or call-out for the APA/agency grade mark on each panel type used
Sheathing schedule showing stud spacing and panel span rating within the limits of Table R602.3(3)
Nailing schedule for wall sheathing matching Table R602.3(1) or R602.3(3) (nail type, size, edge and field spacing)

rules.title: Masonry fireplace construction, footings, seismic reinforcing, firebox, hearth, and clearance
rules.intent: Ensure masonry fireplaces are structurally sound, properly founded, seismically reinforced where required, and adequately separated from combustibles to prevent structural failure and fire hazards.
evidence_required: Foundation/footing detail showing concrete or solid masonry, thickness, projection, and bearing depth
Seismic reinforcing schedule showing vertical bar count/size, horizontal tie spacing, and anchorage straps for SDC C/D0/D1/D2
Firebox section detail with wall thickness, firebrick lining thickness, mortar/firebrick spec citations (ASTM C1261, ASTM C199)
Hearth and hearth extension detail showing thickness and extension dimensions tied to fireplace opening size
Clearance-to-combustibles plan/section showing 2-inch front/side and 4-inch back airspace and fireblocking detail

Residential Type and Building Heating Appliance Chimney

rules.title: Tiny-house lofts: minimum area, dimensions, access stairs/ladders, and loft guards

requires.must_provide: load path for lateral forces between floor framing and braced wall panels located above or below the floor

evidence_required: Braced wall line plan identifying braced wall panels at each story
Section/detail showing connection of braced wall panel to floor framing (top and bottom plates, anchorage, blocking) per R602.10.8
Fastening schedule at rim joist/sill demonstrating continuous load path
Hold-down or strap details where required by R602.10.8

rules.title: Provide minimum bearing length and sill-plate area for joists, beams, and girders
rules.intent: Ensure adequate bearing area at joist/beam/girder ends to prevent crushing of supports and provide stable load transfer to walls and foundations.

lap_at_bearing_support.fastening: minimum three 10d face nails, or wood/metal splice with strength >= nailed lap (R502.6.1)

requires.framing_into_side_of_wood_girder: supported by approved framing anchors or on ledger strips not less than nominal 2x2 (R502.6.2)

evidence_required: Floor framing plan/section showing >=1.5 in bearing on wood or metal supports and >=3 in bearing on masonry/concrete
Sill plate detail showing >=2 in nominal thickness and >=48 sq in bearing area where joists/beams/girders bear on masonry or concrete
Lap detail showing 3 in minimum lap with three 10d face nails, or approved metal splice
Joist hanger or framing-anchor schedule with manufacturer/model and ICC-ES report numbers
Detail of ledger strip (>=2x2 nominal) where joists frame into side of wood girder

rules.title: Use Table R401.4.1 presumptive load-bearing values when no geotechnical evaluation is performed
rules.intent: Establish a default set of allowable soil bearing pressures so footings can be sized without a site-specific geotechnical investigation.

requires.footnote_a: Where soil tests are required by Section R401.4, the allowable bearing capacities shall be part of the recommendations.

evidence_required: Soil classification used for footing design noted on foundation plans or structural calculations
Allowable bearing pressure value (psf) cited in structural calculations referencing Table R401.4.1
If clay/silt soils (CL, ML, MH, CH) are assumed and building official suspects <1,500 psf capacity: soils investigation report with allowable bearing recommendation
Statement on plans confirming no geotechnical evaluation was performed (or reference to one if performed)

rules.title: HCD-regulated foundations and soils investigations shall conform to Health and Safety Code Sections 17953-17957
rules.intent: Ensure that for HCD-regulated residential applications, foundation and soils investigations follow the California statutory requirements for preliminary soil reports and lot-by-lot investigations.

conformance_with: California Health and Safety Code Section 17953
California Health and Safety Code Section 17954
California Health and Safety Code Section 17955
California Health and Safety Code Section 17956
California Health and Safety Code Section 17957

summarized_procedures.requirement: Each city, county, or city and county shall enact an ordinance requiring a preliminary soil report prepared by a state-registered civil engineer, based on adequate test borings or excavations, for every subdivision where a tentative and final map is required pursuant to Government Code Section 66426. Waiver allowed if local agency determines no preliminary analysis is necessary.

If the preliminary report indicates critically expansive soils or other soil problems, ordinance shall require a soil investigation of each lot, prepared by a state-registered civil engineer, recommending corrective action.

Building department shall approve the soil investigation if the recommended action is likely to prevent structural damage; approved corrective action shall be incorporated as a condition of the building permit.
Governing body may enact an ordinance prescribing an alternate procedure equal to or more restrictive than R401.4.1.1.1, R401.4.1.1.2 and R401.1.1.3.

evidence_required: Preliminary soil report stamped by a California-registered civil engineer (or documented agency waiver)
Lot-specific soil investigation report with recommended corrective actions where critically expansive or problematic soils are identified
Building department approval letter for the soil investigation
Building permit conditions explicitly incorporating the approved corrective action into construction documents
Foundation plans/details showing implementation of the recommended corrective action

rules.title: Minimum width, thickness, and projection for concrete footings
rules.intent: Ensure concrete footings are sized adequately for the load and soil bearing capacity, with prescriptive minimums to provide a baseline of structural safety.

width_W.basis: load-bearing value of soil per Table R401.4.1

projection_P.maximum: shall not exceed the thickness of the footing

pier_and_column_footings.sizing_basis: tributary load and allowable soil pressure per Table R401.4.1

evidence_required: Foundation plan showing footing width W, thickness T, and projection P with dimensions
Structural calculation citing Table R403.1(1), R403.1(2), or R403.1(3) and the assumed soil bearing pressure from Table R401.4.1
Section detail demonstrating W >= 12 in, T >= 6 in, and 2 in <= P <= T
For pier/column footings: tributary area calculation and allowable soil pressure used for sizing
For fireplace footings: detail referencing Section R1001.2

rules.title: Flood-resistant design required in flood hazard areas
rules.intent: Ensure buildings located wholly or partly in flood hazard areas are designed and constructed to resist flood loads using the provisions of R322 (or ASCE 24 in floodways).
evidence_required: Site plan showing FEMA flood zone designation (A, V, Coastal A) per Table R301.2
Determination of design flood elevation (DFE) including basis (BFE, FIRM map, jurisdictional map)
Sealed structural calculations demonstrating flotation, collapse, and lateral movement resistance to flood loads
ASCE 24 compliance documentation if building is located in a designated floodway
Registered design professional's seal on flood-design construction documents

rules.title: Elevation, openings, and foundations in A-Zone flood hazard areas
rules.intent: Protect buildings in non-coastal flood hazard areas (A Zones) by elevating the lowest floor above DFE, providing flood openings in enclosed areas below DFE, and using foundations that resist flood loads.
evidence_required: Elevation Certificate or sealed elevation drawing showing lowest-floor elevation vs. BFE+1ft / DFE
Plan and section drawings of flood openings (count, size, sill height, location on different sides)
Engineered-opening certification by registered design professional, if used (per ASCE 24 Section 2.7.2.2)
Foundation drawings demonstrating compliance with Chapter 4 or with the prescriptive masonry exception
Tank anchoring details (calculations and connection details) for underground and above-ground tanks

rules.title: Coastal high-hazard area (V Zone / Coastal A Zone) construction requirements
rules.intent: Protect buildings in coastal high-hazard areas from wave action, scour, and erosion by elevating on pilings or columns, restricting fill, and limiting wall and slab construction below DFE.
evidence_required: Site plan showing mean high tide line and proposed building location
Engineered foundation drawings showing piling/column embedment depth, anchorage, and scour analysis
Sealed calculations for combined wave + wind loads (lateral and uplift) per design flood
Breakaway wall details with calculated collapse load (10-20 psf ASD or sealed engineered design)
R401.4 soil investigation report addressing scour/erosion potential if spread/mat/raft footings proposed
RDP-sealed construction documents per R322.3.9

rules.title: Soil tests when problem soils are likely
rules.intent: Allow the building official to require an approved-method soil test where data indicate expansive, compressible, shifting, or otherwise questionable soils are likely present, so foundation design is based on actual site conditions.
evidence_required: Geotechnical / soils report by an approved agency, sealed by registered civil engineer
Description of test method used and confirmation it is an approved method
Report of allowable bearing capacity (especially where presumptive value < 1,500 psf)
Foundation recommendations addressing identified problem soils (expansive, compressible, shifting)
Building-official approval letter or permit condition incorporating recommendations

rules.title: California HCD: preliminary soil report and lot-level soil investigation for subdivisions
rules.intent: California HCD amendment requiring local jurisdictions to enact ordinances mandating preliminary soil reports for subdivisions and lot-level soil investigations where critically expansive or other problem soils are present.
evidence_required: Preliminary soil report prepared and sealed by California-registered civil engineer, with test boring/excavation logs
Local ordinance citation showing adoption of R401.4.1.1 procedures (or approved alternate)
Lot-by-lot soil investigation report with corrective-action recommendations where critically expansive soils are identified
Building department approval documentation showing recommended actions are incorporated as permit conditions
Construction documents showing recommended corrective action implemented in dwelling foundation design

rules.title: Foundations and slabs on expansive soils
rules.intent: Require engineered foundation and floor slab design per CBC Section 1808.6 when building on expansive soils to mitigate heave/shrink damage.
evidence_required: Soils report classifying site soils as expansive per R403.1.8.1 (PI, sieve, particle-size, or Expansion Index test results)
ASTM D4318 (PI), ASTM D422 (gradation), and/or ASTM D4829 (Expansion Index) laboratory test reports
Sealed foundation and slab design demonstrating compliance with CBC Section 1808.6
If exception used: documentation of comparable site conditions and prior adequate performance, plus building-official written approval
Construction details showing required reinforcement, slab thickness, moisture conditioning, and footing depth

rules.title: Engineered design of free-standing and laterally-loaded retaining walls
rules.intent: Ensure that retaining walls retaining significant unbalanced fill or resisting non-soil lateral loads are engineered for stability against overturning, sliding, bearing, and water uplift with a 1.5 safety factor.
evidence_required: Sealed retaining wall calculations showing overturning, sliding, bearing, and uplift checks
Demonstration of >= 1.5 safety factor for both sliding and overturning
Soil parameters used (active/passive pressures, friction, allowable bearing) consistent with site soils report
Wall section drawings showing height, unbalanced fill, footing dimensions, drainage, and reinforcement
Identification of any surcharge or additional lateral loads beyond retained soil

rules.title: Garages and carports scope
rules.intent: Establish that any garage or carport in a residential project must comply with the floor surface, fire-protection, opener, spring, flood-hazard and EV-infrastructure provisions of Section R309.
evidence_required: Floor plans identifying every garage and carport on the project
Note on cover sheet stating compliance with CRC Section R309
Cross-reference list mapping each R309 subsection to the sheet/detail demonstrating compliance

rules.title: EV charging infrastructure required for new dwellings with attached garages
rules.intent: Ensure newly constructed one- and two-family dwellings and townhouses with attached private garages are pre-wired and equipped per CALGreen so that EV charging can be installed without major electrical retrofit.

requires.referenced_document: California Green Building Standards Code (CALGreen), Chapter 4, Division 4.1
requires.subject: EV charging infrastructure

evidence_required: Electrical single-line diagram showing dedicated raceway from service panel to attached garage
Panel schedule showing reserved breaker space and labeled 'EV CAPABLE' (or equivalent) per CALGreen 4.106.4
Garage interior elevation/detail showing termination location and outlet box for future EVSE
Permit drawing note citing CALGreen Chapter 4, Division 4.1 compliance
Load calculation reserving capacity for the future EV charging branch circuit

rules.title: Referenced codes and standards adopted by reference
rules.intent: Bind every code, standard and publication cited within the CRC (including the 2021 IRC, NFPA standards, UL listings, etc.) into the enforceable body of the code and require recognized engineering practice when a subject is not specifically covered.
evidence_required: Drawing/specification reference to the exact title and edition of each cited standard (e.g., 'UL 325', 'NFPA 13', '2021 IRC')
Code-analysis sheet listing every referenced standard invoked by the design and the CRC section that triggers it
For subjects not specifically covered: stamped engineer/architect narrative documenting the recognized practice applied

rules.title: CRC adopts the 2021 IRC chapter-by-chapter; reserved chapters are not adopted
rules.intent: Tell plan-checkers and designers which IRC chapters carry force of law in California: only chapters that are printed (and not labeled 'Reserved' or 'Not adopted by the State of California') are part of the CRC, with local-ordinance adoption available for the latter.
evidence_required: Code-analysis sheet confirming each cited IRC chapter is printed and not marked 'Reserved' in the 2022 CRC
For any provision relying on a 'Not adopted by the State of California' chapter: copy of the local ordinance adopting that chapter
Designer note stating Matrix Adoption Tables were used only as a guide and not as regulatory text

rules.title: Precast concrete foundations: design and installation conformity
rules.intent: Ensure precast concrete foundations are engineered per the wall design rules and installed per code and the manufacturer's instructions so site assembly matches the approved design.
evidence_required: Stamped precast foundation design package demonstrating compliance with Section R404.5
Manufacturer installation instructions on file with approved drawings
Field inspection records confirming installation matches manufacturer instructions and approved drawings

rules.title: Footings for precast concrete foundations: scope
rules.intent: Direct the designer to the specific footing requirements (crushed stone or concrete) that apply when precast concrete foundations are used.
evidence_required: Foundation plan calling out footing type (crushed stone per R403.4.1 or concrete per R403.4.2) for each precast wall run
Reference on plans to Table R403.4 sizing where crushed stone footings are used
Reference to Figures R403.4(1) and R403.4(2) details on the construction documents

rules.title: Crushed stone footings for precast foundations: material, sizing, lifts, seismic limit
rules.intent: Ensure crushed stone footings under precast foundations use clean, properly graded angular stone, are sized per Table R403.4, are consolidated in adequately thin lifts, and are not used in high seismic categories where their performance is unproven.
evidence_required: Material submittal/cert showing crushed stone meets ASTM C33 with stone size 1/16 in to 1/2 in and angular shape
Soils report or supplier statement confirming stone is free from organic, clayey or silty soils
Foundation detail showing depth (D) and width (W) of crushed stone footing per Table R403.4 for the soil bearing value and number of stories
Inspection record of consolidation in lifts not greater than 8 inches with a vibratory plate
Site Seismic Design Category from R301.2.2 confirming SDC A, B or C

rules.title: Concrete footings under precast foundations: install per R403.1 and Figure R403.4(2)
rules.intent: When concrete footings (rather than crushed stone) are used to support precast foundation walls, they must satisfy the standard concrete footing rules and the precast-specific detail figure.
evidence_required: Foundation plan/details showing concrete footing dimensions per R403.1 (Tables R403.1(1)–(3) and Figure R403.1(1))
Detail showing the precast-to-footing interface per Figure R403.4(2)
Concrete mix submittal meeting the required compressive strength for footings

rules.title: Precast concrete foundation walls: scope
rules.intent: Establish that precast concrete foundation walls are governed by the design, drawing-submittal, and identification subsections of R404.5.
evidence_required: Foundation plan identifying walls as precast concrete and citing Section R404.5
Cross-reference to design (R404.5.1), submitted drawings (R404.5.2), and panel identification (R404.5.3) on the cover sheet or general notes

rules.title: Precast concrete foundation wall design: engineered design, materials, and stamped drawings
rules.intent: Require that precast foundation walls be engineered, that panel materials conform to the precast concrete materials standard or ACI 318, and that the panel drawings carry a registered design professional's seal so the as-built panels match a verified design.
evidence_required: Structural calculations for the precast panels signed by a registered design professional
Materials specification on drawings citing R402.3 or ACI 318 (concrete strength >=5,000 psi at 28 days, reinforcing per ASTM A615/A706M/A996M, fastener grade, etc.)
Panel shop drawings stamped by a registered design professional
Connection details (panel-to-panel and panel-to-footing) consistent with the engineered design

rules.title: Concrete wall materials shall comply with R608.5 (concrete, reinforcement, anchors, forms)
rules.intent: Establish that all materials used to construct concrete walls (concrete, reinforcing steel, anchor bolts, sheet steel, forms, form ties) meet the standards specified in R608.5 and its subsections so the wall achieves the assumed strength and durability.

exceptions.scope: R608.5.1.4 slump limit for removable forms

evidence_required: Concrete mix design specifying f'c >= 2,500 psi at 28 days, cement type per ASTM C150/C595/C1157, slump limits, and aggregate gradation
Reinforcing steel mill certifications showing compliance with ASTM A615, A706, or A996
Anchor bolt and sheet-steel material specifications and certifications (ASTM A307/F1554; ASTM A653/A792/A875 SS, minimum Grade 33)
Form manufacturer data sheets and, for flat ICF systems, conformance to ASTM E2634
Slump and compressive-strength test reports per ASTM C143 and applicable cylinder tests

rules.title: Reinforcement installation: secure placement, cover, lap splices, development, hooks, and waffle-grid web restrictions
rules.intent: Ensure reinforcing steel is positioned, covered, spliced, developed, hooked, and (for waffle-grid webs) excluded as required so the prescriptive structural performance assumed in R608.6 through R608.8 is actually achieved in the field.

requires.waffle_grid_web_restriction: no reinforcement (including stirrups) in webs; form ties permitted

evidence_required: Reinforcement placement details on plans showing bar size, spacing, and required cover for each wall type and exposure (earth, weather, removable form, stay-in-place form)
Lap splice schedule referencing Table R608.5.4(1) with bar size, grade, splice length, and noncontact-gap limits
Tension development length and hook details per Table R608.5.4(1) and Figures R608.5.4(2) and R608.5.4(3)
Note prohibiting reinforcement (including stirrups) in waffle-grid webs
If alternate bar size/grade is used, calculations or tabular reference to Table R608.5.4(2) showing equivalent area of steel per linear foot

rules.title: Above-grade concrete walls: minimum thickness, reinforcement, and lateral support per R608.6
rules.intent: Ensure above-grade concrete walls (load-bearing and nonload-bearing) have prescribed minimum thickness, vertical and horizontal reinforcement for wind, support on continuous foundations, and lateral support to floor/roof framing so out-of-plane and in-plane loads are resisted.

requires.supported_on: continuous foundation walls or slabs-on-ground monolithic with the footing per R403
requires.wall_thickness_relative_to_story_above: >= thickness of wall in story above

placement: top bar within 12 in of top of wall
bottom bar within 12 in of finish floor
one bar at approximately one-third wall height
one bar at approximately two-thirds wall height

design_required_per_ACI_318_when: wall or building outside limitations of R608.2
design required by tables in this section
wall not within scope of tables

evidence_required: Wall schedule on plans listing wall type (flat/waffle/screen), nominal thickness, and vertical bar size and spacing taken from Table R608.6(1)-(4) for the design wind speed and exposure
Foundation detail showing continuous foundation wall or monolithic slab-on-ground footing per Section R403
Corner detail showing a vertical bar at corners of exterior walls
Horizontal reinforcement schedule showing four No. 4 bars at the prescribed elevations (or the larger amount required by R608.7.2.2.1)
Lateral connection details from wall to floor and roof framing per Section R608.9; ACI 318 calculations if outside R608.2 limits

rules.title: Solid walls for lateral-force resistance: minimum length, segments, and reinforcement
rules.intent: Require each exterior wall line to contain a code-prescribed total length of solid-wall segments (with minimum segment length, maximum opening width, and corner placement) so the building has adequate in-plane shear resistance to wind.

requires.equation: TL >= R1 * R2 * R3 * UR  (Equation R6-1)

evidence_required: Plan showing each exterior endwall and sidewall line with marked solid-wall segments, segment lengths, and total length TL compared to UR x R1 x R2 x R3
Calculation table or notes for reduction factors R1 (mean roof height), R2 (floor-to-ceiling height) and R3 (design strength) referencing Tables R608.7.1.1(4), (5), and (6)
Dimensioned details verifying minimum 24-in segment length, no more than two 24-to-<48-in segments per line, maximum 18-ft clear opening, and segment ends within 6 ft of each corner
Vertical-end and shear reinforcement schedule for each solid wall segment per Section R608.7.2.2 and Table R608.7.1.1(6)
Detail of any utility openings within solid wall segments confirming they are < 30 sq in, no dimension > 6-1/4 in, and at least 6 in from segment side edges

rules.title: Reinforcement around openings and lintels for openings >= 2 ft wide
rules.intent: Ensure that wall openings of at least 2 feet receive supplemental horizontal and vertical reinforcement, a properly designed lintel, and adequate concrete depth above so the opening does not undermine the wall's gravity and shear capacity.

horizontal_reinforcement.bottom_of_opening_bar: not less than one No. 4 bar within 12 in of bottom of opening
horizontal_reinforcement.extension_beyond_edges: develop the bar in tension per Section R608.5.4.4

requires.waffle_or_screen_grid_opening_location: not less than one-half of a vertical core occurs along each side of the opening

stirrups.max_spacing: d/2 where d = lintel depth D minus cover
stirrups.hooks: 135-degree standard hooks at one end (single bar or two bundled bars); 90- or 135-degree hooks at free end per Section R608.5.4.5 and Figure R608.5.4(3)

evidence_required: Opening detail per Figure R608.8(1) showing one No. 4 bar within 12 in of bottom of opening, with bar extensions developed in tension per R608.5.4.4
Vertical reinforcement schedule showing one No. 4 [Grade 40] bar each side of the opening, full story height, within 12 in of opening side
Minimum concrete depth over openings: 8 in for flat/waffle-grid, 12 in for screen-grid; openings in waffle/screen-grid located so at least half a vertical core occurs each side
Lintel schedule with clear span, bar size, stirrup size and spacing (d/2), and standard hook details per Tables R608.8(2)-(8) and Figures R608.8(2)-(4)
ACI 318 design calculations for lintels supporting concentrated loads (e.g., roof or floor beams or girders)

rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof minimum slope
rules.intent: Ensure positive drainage on thermoset single-ply (EPDM) membrane roofs to prevent ponding and premature membrane failure.
evidence_required: Roof plan and section details showing design slope of at least 1/4:12 (2%)
Drainage plan or roof drain layout demonstrating positive drainage
Manufacturer's installation instructions confirming acceptable slope range

rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof material standards
rules.intent: Ensure thermoset single-ply roof coverings meet recognized material specifications for durability and weather resistance.
evidence_required: Product data sheet or manufacturer specification identifying compliance with ASTM D4637 or ASTM D5019
Third-party test report or certification of conformance to the cited ASTM standard
Roofing material submittal stamped/approved for the specified roof assembly

rules.title: Thermoset (EPDM) single-ply roof installation per chapter and manufacturer instructions
rules.intent: Ensure thermoset single-ply roof systems are installed consistent with code provisions and the manufacturer's tested system to maintain warranty and performance.
evidence_required: Manufacturer's printed installation instructions submitted with the roofing package
Installer certification or training credential from the membrane manufacturer (if required by manufacturer)
Roof assembly detail drawings showing seams, terminations, flashings, and fasteners per manufacturer specifications
Inspection records or special inspection report verifying installation per manufacturer's instructions

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof minimum slope
rules.intent: Ensure positive drainage on thermoplastic single-ply membrane roofs (TPO/PVC) to prevent ponding water and protect the membrane.
evidence_required: Roof plan and section details showing design slope of at least 1/4:12 (2%)
Drainage / roof drain layout confirming positive drainage to drains or scuppers
Manufacturer's installation instructions confirming acceptable slope range

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof material standards
rules.intent: Ensure thermoplastic single-ply roof coverings meet recognized ASTM material specifications for the specific membrane chemistry (PVC, KEE, or TPO).
evidence_required: Product data sheet or manufacturer specification identifying compliance with ASTM D4434 (PVC), D6754 (KEE), or D6878 (TPO)
Third-party test report or listing showing conformance to the cited ASTM standard
Roofing material submittal stamped/approved for the specified roof assembly

rules.title: Thermoplastic (TPO/PVC) single-ply roof installation per chapter and manufacturer instructions
rules.intent: Ensure thermoplastic single-ply roof systems are installed consistent with code provisions and the manufacturer's tested system to achieve weather-tight performance.
evidence_required: Manufacturer's printed installation instructions submitted with the roofing package
Installer certification from the membrane manufacturer (if required)
Roof assembly detail drawings showing welded seams, terminations, flashings, and attachment per manufacturer specifications
Inspection records or special inspection report verifying installation per manufacturer's instructions

rules.title: Provide carbon monoxide alarms in dwelling units with fuel-fired appliances or attached garage
rules.intent: Ensure carbon monoxide alarms are installed in dwelling units that have credible CO sources so occupants are warned of dangerous CO levels.
evidence_required: Floor plan annotation identifying each dwelling unit and presence of fuel-fired appliances/fireplaces or attached garages with openings to the dwelling
CO alarm cut sheet/spec showing UL 2034 listing (or UL 217 + UL 2034 for combination CO/smoke alarms)
California State Fire Marshal (SFM) approval/listing documentation for the specified device
Scope-of-work narrative for additions/alterations indicating whether CO alarms were previously required

rules.title: Install carbon monoxide alarms at required locations within dwelling units
rules.intent: Place CO alarms where they will reliably wake sleeping occupants and detect CO on every habitable level.

locations.description: Outside of each separate sleeping area in the immediate vicinity of the bedrooms
On every occupiable level of a dwelling unit, including basements
Within a bedroom where a fuel-burning appliance is located within the bedroom or its attached bathroom

evidence_required: Floor plans showing CO alarm symbols at each required location (outside sleeping areas, each occupiable level including basement, and inside bedrooms with fuel-burning appliances)
Manufacturer installation instructions for the specified CO alarm
Identification of fuel-burning appliances inside any bedroom or its attached bathroom on mechanical/architectural plans
Reflected ceiling/electrical plan confirming alarm mounting locations

rules.title: Interconnect multiple carbon monoxide alarms within a dwelling unit
rules.intent: Ensure that activation of any one CO alarm sounds all alarms throughout the dwelling so occupants in any area receive warning.
evidence_required: Electrical plan or alarm-system diagram showing interconnection wiring (or wireless listing for each alarm)
Listing/spec sheet demonstrating wireless alarms are listed and sound in unison when one activates
Quantity and locations of CO alarms required by R315.3 (to confirm whether more than one is required)
For pre-2011 existing buildings claiming exception: dated permit history/build records and scope-of-work statement matching one of the listed conditions

rules.title: Power carbon monoxide alarms from building wiring with battery backup
rules.intent: Ensure CO alarms remain operational under both normal building power and during power interruptions, with no inadvertent disconnect.
evidence_required: Electrical plan showing CO alarms connected to permanent building wiring served from commercial power
Confirmation that the alarm circuit has no disconnecting switch other than overcurrent protection (panel schedule/single-line)
Manufacturer spec sheet showing battery backup capability
If exception claimed: documentation of building age (pre-2011), occupancy classification (Group R), absence of commercial power, or scope-of-work statement matching the cited exception

rules.title: Separate foam plastic from interior with an approved thermal barrier
rules.intent: Limit fire growth and protect occupants by interposing a code-approved thermal barrier between any interior space and foam plastic insulation.
evidence_required: Wall/ceiling/floor section drawings showing the thermal barrier layer and its thickness
Manufacturer specification sheet identifying the gypsum wallboard, wood structural panel, or tested barrier product
If alternative material: NFPA 275 test report demonstrating compliance with both Temperature Transmission Fire Test and Integrity Fire Test
Material schedule on the construction documents calling out the approved thermal barrier

rules.title: Attic foam plastic must have an ignition barrier or be tested when thermal barrier is omitted
rules.intent: Where the R316.4 thermal barrier is omitted in attics, fire-ignition risk is mitigated by limiting attic entry to maintenance and protecting foam plastic with an approved ignition barrier or equivalent fire test.
evidence_required: Attic detail drawings showing foam plastic location and the proposed ignition barrier (material and thickness called out)
Confirmation that an attic access opening complying with R807.1 is provided on the plans
Note on plans restricting attic entry to repairs or maintenance only
If foregoing the ignition barrier: third-party test report demonstrating the foam plastic was tested in accordance with R316.6
Manufacturer product data for the ignition barrier material confirming the listed thickness/base-metal thickness

rules.title: Crawl space foam plastic must have an ignition barrier or be tested when thermal barrier is omitted
rules.intent: Where the R316.4 thermal barrier is omitted in crawl spaces, fire-ignition risk is mitigated by limiting entry to maintenance and protecting foam plastic with an approved ignition barrier or equivalent fire test.
evidence_required: Crawl space section/detail drawings showing foam plastic location and ignition barrier material and thickness
Confirmation on plans that crawl space access is provided per R408.4
Note on plans restricting crawl space entry to repairs or maintenance only
If foregoing the ignition barrier: third-party test report demonstrating the foam plastic was tested in accordance with R316.6
Manufacturer product data for the chosen ignition barrier material confirming compliance with the listed thickness

rules.title: Provide minimum-sized access openings to all under-floor (crawl) spaces
rules.intent: Ensure under-floor spaces are physically accessible for inspection, maintenance, and repair through a code-sized access opening, and to support the R316.5.4 ignition-barrier exemption that depends on this access.
evidence_required: Foundation/floor plan showing location and clear dimensions of every under-floor access opening
Detail confirming through-floor openings are at least 18 in x 24 in or through-wall openings are at least 16 in x 24 in
Areaway detail (size and depth) where any portion of a through-wall access is below grade, showing areaway bottom below the access threshold
Plan note confirming through-wall access is not located beneath any door to the residence
Cross-reference to California Mechanical Code access provisions where mechanical equipment is under-floor

rules.title: Foam plastic surface burning characteristics
rules.intent: Limit flame spread and smoke development of foam plastic used in building construction so that it does not contribute to rapid interior fire growth.

thickness_rules.<=4_in: test at maximum thickness and density intended for use
thickness_rules.>4_in: test at 4-inch thickness; end use approved per R316.6

exceptions.effect: alternative_thresholds: flame_spread_index_max=25, smoke_developed_index_max=450 at 4-inch test thickness; must be separated from interior by 1/2-inch gypsum or NFPA 275 tested material

evidence_required: Foam plastic product spec sheet listing flame spread index and smoke-developed index values
ASTM E84 or UL 723 test report at intended thickness and density
Manufacturer's listing showing thickness, density, and end-use configuration
If thicker than 4 in: R316.6 specific approval documentation

rules.title: Rooftop PV fire classification matches roof assembly
rules.intent: Ensure rooftop-mounted photovoltaic systems do not degrade the fire classification of the roof they are installed on.
evidence_required: PV module/system listing showing UL 2703 fire classification (Class A, B, or C)
Roof assembly fire classification (Class A in FHSZ per R902.1.1)
Cross-check showing PV class is at least equal to roof class
Manufacturer installation instructions and product listing
rules._rule_pack: WUI Fire Compliance & PV Fire Class

rules.title: Rooftop PV roof penetrations flashed and sealed
rules.intent: Prevent water intrusion and maintain roof assembly integrity at PV mounting penetrations.
evidence_required: Mounting detail drawings showing flashing at every roof penetration
Manufacturer-approved flashing/sealant product cut sheets
Inspection sign-off for roof penetration weatherproofing

rules.title: WUI exterior wildfire exposure scope (parent trigger)
rules.intent: Scope rule: triggers application of the entire R337 ignition-resistance rule subtree for new buildings located in WUI fire areas or Fire Hazard Severity Zones.
evidence_required: FHSZ / WUI determination for project site (CAL FIRE map, jurisdictional declaration)
Building permit application date
Site plan showing distances between accessory and applicable buildings
Vegetation management compliance per California Fire Code 4906/4907 (R337.1.5)

rules.title: Ignition-resistant material requirements
rules.intent: Ensure exterior building materials used in WUI areas demonstrate ignition resistance through standardized fire testing or qualify as a recognized alternative (noncombustible, FRTW, FRT shingles).
evidence_required: Product listing showing ASTM E84 / UL 723 extended (30-min) flame spread index <= 25
Test report showing flame front did not progress > 10.5 ft beyond burner centerline
If FRTW: ASTM D2898 weathering test report and CBC 2303.2 compliance
State Fire Marshal listing or approved-agency evaluation report
Identification label on product (R337.3.4)

rules.title: WUI roofing general — Class A in FHSZ
rules.intent: Require Class A roof assemblies in WUI Fire Hazard Severity Zones to resist burning ember and direct flame exposure on the roof.
evidence_required: Roof covering listing showing ASTM E108 or UL 790 Class A result
FHSZ determination for project address
Manufacturer installation instructions matched to permit drawings
Roofing assembly approval documentation

rules.title: WUI roof coverings — cap sheet under profiled roofing on combustible deck
rules.intent: Prevent ember intrusion under profiled (airspace) roof coverings on combustible decks by requiring an underlayment cap sheet, bird stops, and mudded hip/ridge caps.
evidence_required: Roofing detail/section showing 72 lb cap sheet to ASTM D3909, or noncombustible separator
Bird stop product cut sheet and installation note at eaves
Spec note that hip and ridge caps are mudded in
Class A underlayment listing if alternate method used

rules.title: WUI roof valley flashing
rules.intent: Provide a noncombustible, ember-resistant flashing assembly at valleys where debris and embers can accumulate.
evidence_required: Roof plan and valley detail showing 36-inch wide flashing full length of valley
Material spec for No. 26 gauge (0.019 in) galvanized corrosion-resistant metal flashing
ASTM D3909 cap sheet underlayment cut sheet

rules.title: WUI exterior covering scope (parent)
rules.intent: Scope rule: triggers exterior covering compliance for wall coverings/assemblies, eaves, soffits, porch ceilings, floor projections, and underfloor areas in WUI areas.
evidence_required: Building elevations identifying exterior covering material at each face

rules.title: WUI exterior wall coverings
rules.intent: Require exterior wall coverings in WUI areas to be noncombustible, ignition-resistant, or fire-retardant-treated wood so they resist short-term direct flame and ember exposure.

requires.extent: from top of foundation to roof; terminate at 2-inch nominal solid wood blocking between rafters at all roof overhangs, or at the enclosure for enclosed eaves

evidence_required: Wall covering product listing (noncombustible, ignition-resistant per R337.4.2, or FRTW)
Exterior-use labeling on product
Wall section showing covering extent from foundation to roof with proper termination
If FRTW: CBC 2303.2 compliance documentation

rules.title: WUI exterior wall assemblies
rules.intent: Permit alternative compliance via fully tested exterior wall assemblies (tested for direct flame penetration or 1-hour fire resistance) instead of compliant individual coverings.

conditions: no glowing combustion at end of 70-minute test

evidence_required: Tested wall assembly listing (ASTM E2707, SFM 12-7A-1, ASTM E119, or UL 263)
Wall section drawing matching the listed assembly
If gypsum option: 5/8-in Type X cut sheet and installation note
Conditions of acceptance per R337.7.4.1 verified in test report

rules.title: WUI exterior windows, skylights, and exterior glazed doors
rules.intent: Require exterior glazing to resist breakage from radiant heat and direct flame so that fire and embers do not enter through window/skylight/door openings.

exterior_doors_any_of: solid core wood (stiles/rails >=1-3/8 in, panels >=1-1/4 in)
cladding tested per ASTM E2707 to R337.7.3.1

evidence_required: Window/skylight/door schedule showing complying option (tempered, glass block, NFPA 257, or SFM 12-7A-2)
Tempered glass certification (R308) or fire-resistance test report
Exterior door spec showing solid core dimensions or fire/test rating
Garage door weatherstrip product cut sheet showing ASTM D638 / G155 / UL 94 V-2 compliance
Skylight mesh detail with 1/8-in noncombustible mesh

rules.title: WUI decking walking surface within 10 ft of building
rules.intent: Prevent decks/porches/balconies/stairs near a building from igniting under burning brand exposure and contributing to building ignition.

requires.flashing_required_at_deck_to_wall: min 6-inch (150 mm) metal flashing applied vertically

evidence_required: Decking product test report (ASTM E2632 + ASTM E2726, SFM 12-7A-4, or alternates)
Conditions of acceptance verification (peak HRR <= 25 kW/ft^2; no sustained combustion)
Deck plan showing surfaces within 10 ft of building
Detail showing 6-inch vertical metal flashing at deck-to-wall intersections

rules.title: Class A roof required in Fire Hazard Severity Zones
rules.intent: Require Class A roof coverings on all new structures and substantial roof replacements within Fire Hazard Severity Zones to defend against ember and direct flame exposure.
evidence_required: FHSZ determination for project address (CAL FIRE map screenshot or jurisdiction declaration)
Roof covering listing showing ASTM E108 or UL 790 Class A result

rules.title: Fire-retardant-treated wood shakes/shingles
rules.intent: Permit FRT wood shakes/shingles only when full-cell pressure-treated, qualified by UBC 15-2 for the required class, weather-tested, and labeled by an accredited agency.

requires.weathering_compliance: ICC-ES EG107 and Health and Safety Code Section 13132.7(j)
requires.labeling: ICBO accredited quality control agency label on each bundle, identifying classification and EG107/H&SC 13132.7(j) compliance

evidence_required: State Fire Marshal listing for FRT wood shakes/shingles
ICC-ES EG107 evaluation report
Bundle labels showing UBC 15-2 qualification class and ICC-ES EG107 / 13132.7(j) compliance
Documentation of natural weathering test (>=5 years of 10-year test passed)
UBC 15-3 or 15-4 compliance certificate

rules.title: BIPV fire classification — UL 7103
rules.intent: Ensure building-integrated PV products serving as roof covering carry an equivalent UL 7103 fire classification matching the base roof requirements.

requires.lot_line_proximity_rule: Class A, B, or C BIPV products shall be installed where the edge of the roof is less than 3 ft (914 mm) from a lot line

evidence_required: BIPV product UL 7103 listing showing fire classification
Site plan with lot line distance to roof edge
Cross-check that BIPV class meets R902.1.1 (FHSZ) or R902.1.2 baseline

rules.title: Rooftop-mounted PV panel systems — UL 2703 fire classification
rules.intent: Require rooftop-mounted PV panel systems to be tested/listed/identified for a fire classification (UL 2703) and installed per their listing where the law or lot-line proximity requires it.

requires.class_required_when: jurisdictions designated by law OR roof edge < 3 ft (914 mm) from a lot line

evidence_required: PV system UL 2703 listing showing fire classification
Manufacturer's installation instructions and listing details
Site plan showing lot line distance to roof edge
Local jurisdiction PV-class requirement reference (if applicable)
